name: Date A Live: Twin Edition Rio Reincarnation
original_name: デート・ア・ライブ Twin Edition 凜緒リンカーネイション
source:
That day, Shidou felt something strange with the duplicate key he found in his house. The thing that he should have handed it to someone for sure. However, he doesn't remember to whom he should have handed it to. At that moment, a small noise appeared above his head, and takes the consciousness of Shidou.
Upon being awakened, Shidou found himself in a world where Arusu Maria exist, who does not have a physical body in reality. And then, a certain girl appeared before Shido.
Sonogami Rinne ― At one time, a girl that Shidou had failed to save.
Shidou, who regained the memories of when he had known, becomes possible to investigate the cause of the resurgence of Eden <Paradise of Calamity>.
In the midst of it, who appeared before Shido was, a young girl whose appearance resembles that of <Ruler> ― Rio.
"It's no good if you don't find the most important thing to you."
What does Rio means by "the most important thing"? Is she an existence related to Eden <Paradise of Calamity>?
In this closed world, the action should Shido take in order to regain the everyday life is only one―
By dating and make them fall in love!?

[From [url=http://date-a-live.wikia.com/wiki/Date_A_Live_Twin_Edition:_Rio_Reincarnation]DAL Wiki[/url]]
translation:
那天，士道对在家里发现的备用钥匙感到奇怪。他肯定应该把钥匙交给某个人，却想不起该交给谁。就在这时，头顶传来细微声响，士道失去了意识。
醒来后，士道发现自己身处一个阿鲁斯·玛利亚存在的世界，而她在现实中并没有实体。随后，一名少女出现在士道面前。
园神凛祢——曾经那个士道没能拯救的女孩。
恢复相关记忆后，士道得以调查伊甸园〈灾厄乐园〉复苏的原因。
此时，出现在士道面前的是一名外貌与〈统治者〉相似的少女——莉欧。
“如果不找到对你来说最重要的东西，就不行。”
莉欧所说的“最重要的东西”究竟是什么？她是否与伊甸园〈灾厄乐园〉有关？
在这个封闭世界里，士道想要恢复日常生活，唯一能采取的行动就是——
和她们约会，让她们坠入爱河！？

[来自[url=http://date-a-live.wikia.com/wiki/Date_A_Live_Twin_Edition:_凛绪_Reincarnation]DAL Wiki[/url]]
